parts.label: (a)
parts.text:
Prepare, cook and serve three skilful dishes, each to show the use of a different convenience
food from the following list:
canned pulses, dried fruit, frozen vegetables, puff pastry, tinned fish.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text: Make a cake using the whisking method OR make a batch of biscuits.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text:
Prepare, cook and serve a balanced main meal for two relatives who cannot eat dairy
products.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text: Make a dish using cheese OR make a cake using the creaming method.

text: Prepare, cook and serve four skilful dishes, each to show a different use of eggs from the following
aerating, binding, coating, emulsifying, garnishing, glazing, thickening.
At least two of the dishes must be savoury.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text: Prepare, cook and serve a balanced main meal for two office workers.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text: Make a dish using a herb OR a dish using chocolate.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text: Prepare, cook and serve two skilful dishes, each to show the use of a different spice.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text: Make a dish using pasta AND make a batch of small cakes or a tray bake.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text: Prepare, cook and serve a balanced main meal for two children who are five years old.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
Make a savoury dish using shortcrust pastry OR make some biscuits using the melting
method.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text:
Prepare, cook and serve two skilful dishes, each using a different root vegetable as a main
ingredient.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text: Make a sweet dish using the whisking method AND make a batch of scones.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text:
Prepare, cook and serve three skilful savoury dishes to be served cold at a buffet for your
friend’s birthday party. Dishes at the cold buffet should be suitable for eating without cutlery.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
Make a decorated birthday cake for your friend.
